_comment: PLACEHOLDER SCHEDULE. None of this is confirmed and the speakers named
here are invented. Replace this file, or point SCHEDULE_URL at a
published sheet, before the site is public.
One entry per session. `speakers` may be empty — a break or a lunch is
still a row on the schedule, and the layouts expect to meet one.
`until`, `track`, `format` and `summary` are all optional. A session with
none of them is a time and a title, and still renders.
